boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Catholic University observances, ceremonies, and campus rituals.

cards.title: Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Academic-year opening, Basilica of the National Shrine
cards.notes: Join the University-wide opening liturgy at the neighboring Basilica; the University identifies it as an annual tradition at the start of the school year.
cards.short_summary: A University-wide prayerful opening to the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University describes the Mass of the Holy Spirit as an annual University tradition held at the beginning of each school year.
cards.source_title: Students Called to Unity and Prayer During Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.access_notes: University-wide liturgy; consult Campus Ministry for the current date and attendance details.

cards.entity_name: First-Year Student Convocation and University Pins
cards.title: The pin ceremony for new Cardinals
cards.subtitle: First-year convocation, Basilica of the National Shrine
cards.notes: Attend the first-year convocation and look for the University-pin presentation, whose motto reads “Deus Lux Mea Est” (“God is my light”).
cards.short_summary: New students receive pins marking membership in the University community.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University's annual first-year convocation concludes with students receiving University pins bearing the University's motto.
cards.source_title: Class of 2027 Encouraged to Dream, Make One Another Better
cards.access_notes: For incoming first-year students; timing is set during the fall semester.

cards.title: Spring starts with St. Thomas Aquinas
cards.subtitle: Patron-saint Mass, Basilica of the National Shrine
cards.notes: Mark the spring-semester opening at the patron-saint Mass; the procession includes faculty in academic regalia and a ceremonial mace.
cards.short_summary: A formal University Mass honoring its patron saint.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University calls the Mass of St. Thomas Aquinas an annual event held in honor of the University's patron saint.
cards.source_title: Solemn Mass of St. Thomas Aquinas Ushers in Spring Semester at Catholic University
cards.access_notes: University-wide event; check the University's calendar for the current year's details.

cards.entity_name: Las Mañanitas and Mass for Our Lady of Guadalupe
cards.title: Las Mañanitas for Our Lady of Guadalupe
cards.subtitle: December 12, St. Vincent de Paul Chapel
cards.notes: Observe the December 12 campus celebration, which pairs Las Mañanitas with Mass for Our Lady of Guadalupe at St. Vincent de Paul Chapel.
cards.short_summary: A campus Our Lady of Guadalupe observance with Las Mañanitas and Mass.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University's cultural calendar lists Las Mañanitas and Mass for Our Lady of Guadalupe on December 12.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of the University's cultural expressions of Catholicism; confirm the current calendar before attending.

cards.title: Archaeology graduates get fedoras
cards.subtitle: Post-Commencement ceremony, Hannan Hall
cards.notes: If you are an archaeology graduate, attend the post-Commencement reception where faculty award replica Indiana Jones fedoras to graduating seniors.
cards.short_summary: A 15-year archaeology-program rite centered on a replica fedora.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University documents an annual, 15-year tradition in which archaeology graduating seniors receive replica Indiana Jones fedoras after Commencement.
cards.source_title: The Next Indiana Jones Could Come From Catholic University, Not Hollywood
cards.access_notes: Program-specific post-Commencement ceremony for archaeology graduates.

cards.title: University Research Day
cards.subtitle: Annual campus research showcase
cards.notes: Browse posters, talks, demonstrations, and presentations during the University’s full-day celebration of student, faculty, and staff research.
cards.short_summary: The University's annual all-discipline research showcase.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University describes University Research Day as its premier annual research event, bringing the community together for a full day.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; review the Research Day site for the current program and attendance information.

cards.title: Cardinal Weekend
cards.subtitle: Homecoming and reunion weekend, Catholic University campus
cards.notes: Plan around the homecoming weekend’s campus tours, athletic events, reunions, lectures, and parade; the University calls it a cherished annual tradition.
cards.short_summary: A multi-day homecoming tradition for students, families, and alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University describes Cardinal Weekend as a cherished annual tradition with reunions, athletics, tours, lectures, and a parade.
cards.access_notes: Dates and individual activities vary by year; confirm the current Cardinal Weekend schedule.

cards.title: MLK Jr. Day of Service
cards.subtitle: Washington metropolitan area service projects
cards.notes: Register for the University’s MLK Day service projects, organized through Campus Ministry and Cardinal Service Corps to honor Dr. King’s legacy.
cards.short_summary: A campus service-day tradition held in the Washington area.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University identifies its MLK Jr. Day of Service as an annual tradition organized by Campus Ministry and Cardinal Service Corps.
cards.source_title: The Catholic University of America Magazine: Striving for Service and Sustainability
cards.access_notes: Service locations and registration information vary annually; consult Campus Ministry before participating.

cards.title: Freshman Retreat
cards.subtitle: First-year weekend retreat, Sandy Hill Camp and Retreat Center
cards.notes: First-year students can register for the longstanding weekend retreat, designed to welcome new Cardinals through prayer, leisure, sacraments, and small groups.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding first-year retreat that introduces students to campus faith life.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University calls Freshman Retreat a longstanding tradition and reports that nearly 300 first-year students attended the 2025 retreat.
cards.source_title: A Critical Moment: Adapting to Change
cards.access_notes: The University's 2026 retreats page lists Freshman Retreat for September 11–13 at Sandy Hill and a $50 cost.

cards.title: Frassati Fest’s new fall rhythm
cards.subtitle: Family Weekend evening, Catholic University campus
cards.notes: Watch for the Family Weekend evening that combines Mass, student performances, games, a rosary, Eucharistic holy hour, Confession, and Benediction.
cards.short_summary: A new Campus Ministry Family Weekend observance honoring St. Pier Giorgio Frassati.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University reports that its first Frassati Fest was held during Family Weekend in 2025 and says the new tradition is intended to continue each fall.
cards.source_title: First-ever Frassati Fest: Faith, Fellowship, Fun
cards.access_notes: A newly established event; verify future scheduling with Campus Ministry or the Family Weekend calendar.
